merchant.name: Selene of the Lantern Market
merchant.source: registered NPC merchant wallet; must be included in initial world ledger totals

offer_generation: From six unique relics, seed three distinct offers at shop-node creation and persist inventory/price; cannot reroll via save/reload

other_offers.effect: Replace exactly one currently owned base spell instance with a different starter base spell, preserving Spellbook length; its Resonance resets to zero.

checkout: player.Lifechips - price >=1, inventory space available, item present, transfer atomic to merchant wallet
cannot_buy_message: The Ledger forbids a purchase that would surrender your final Lifechip.
sold_out_message: That relic has already passed into another hand.
wallet_accounting: purchase debit player and credit merchant exact same amount; merchant cannot invent refunds; refunds are transfers from actual merchant balance
